intro.heading: 🌟 Introduction to PM Mudra Loan 🌟
intro.content: The PM Mudra Loan is a government-backed loan scheme designed to support small businesses and entrepreneurs in India 🇮🇳. The scheme provides funding up to ₹10 lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities 🤑. In this article, we will guide you through the process of applying for a PM Mudra Loan online in 2026 📆.

sections.heading: 📈 Benefits of PM Mudra Loan 📈
sections.content: The PM Mudra Loan offers several benefits to small businesses and entrepreneurs, including 🌟 low interest rates, 🌟 minimal documentation, and 🌟 easy repayment terms. The loan can be used for a variety of purposes, such as 🛍️ working capital, 🏢 business expansion, and 🚀 equipment purchase.

sections.heading: 📝 Eligibility Criteria for PM Mudra Loan 📝
sections.content: To be eligible for a PM Mudra Loan, you must meet the following criteria 📝: you must be an Indian citizen 🇮🇳, you must be above 18 years of age 🎂, and you must have a business plan 📊. Additionally, your business must be in the non-corporate, non-farm sector 🌾.

sections.heading: 📁 Required Documents for PM Mudra Loan 📁
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan, you will need to provide the following documents 📁: 📝 identity proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, etc.), 📝 address proof (passport, driving license, etc.), 📝 business proof (business registration certificate, etc.), and 📝 income proof (bank statement, etc.).

sections.heading: 📊 Step-by-Step Online Application Process 📊
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan online, follow these steps 📊: ✅ visit the official website of the lender or the PM Mudra Loan portal, ✅ fill out the online application form, ✅ upload the required documents, and ✅ submit the application. You will receive a confirmation email or SMS once your application is submitted 📱.

faqs.q: What is the interest rate for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The interest rate for PM Mudra Loan varies between 8.5% to 12.5% per annum 📊.

faqs.q: What is the repayment tenure for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The repayment tenure for PM Mudra Loan is up to 5 years 📆.

faqs.q: Can I apply for PM Mudra Loan online?
faqs.a: Yes, you can apply for PM Mudra Loan online through the official website of the lender or the PM Mudra Loan portal 📈.
